name: Brevo Contact Sync
description: Syncing brevo contacts in drupal Users
project_description: Brevo Contact Sync pushes Drupal user records to Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) contacts through the sendinblue_api module's stored API key. An administrator maps user fields (base fields such as name/mail/status/roles plus any field_* field) to Brevo contact attributes on a mapping form and picks a target Brevo contact list. On every user entity save the module reads the mappings, extracts values (with per-type handling for string, boolean, integer, decimal, float, list_string, datetime, timestamp, link, entity_reference, file and address fields, plus a Key/Value option that chooses between a field's stored key and its human label), then calls the official Brevo PHP SDK to create the contact or, if it already exists, update it — assigning it to the selected list. It requires the Brevo: Digital Marketing Tool (sendinblue_api) module for API credentials and Drupal 10 or 11.
